newsitem.title: USA: Ex-CEO sues Northstar Health Services.
newsitem.headline: Ex-CEO sues Northstar Health Services.

text.p: The former chairman and chief executive officer of Northstar Health Services Inc said Thursday he had filed a lawsuit seeking to invalidate recent actions taken by the Northstar board.

Thomas Zaucha, who is leading a proxy fight to gain control of the company, contends the board measures attempt to strip stockholders of corporate governance rights, including a right to replace the board.
The lawsuit was filed in Delaware Chancery Court.
Zaucha said the board removed him from his posts on February 18 after accusing him of a conflict of interest.
